evidence: Source configuration conforms to quality check 10. Frozen task/task.toml:28 sets environment_mode = "separate". Lines 30-35 are byte-equal to the frozen template verifier environment: claude-code, z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, OpenRouter /api URL, ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} authentication reference and empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Lines 37-38 allow public network, as the current public workbook/skill require; the older internal sheet allowlist wording is superseded. All five parsed [judge] tables have the expected claude-code fallback (each judge.toml:2) and no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight override. tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd): version-tagged node:22-bookworm-slim/python:3.12-slim bases (1-2), exact npm versions (17-21), RewardKit==0.1.7 (31), browser installation from the pinned MCP distribution (33-38). These are the supplied template pins, not immutable digest pins; no task-specific harness change is justified. Build log:59 records image sha256:958902dedd30475f2f1e94c046b1b718b0c76d18cc733486bb81dfdbf61f3bc6. Installed configured-inspection/results.json (SHA256 68a8e192fc287fa192052ca0c74eccdcda93ba0d28f440641f0ef8337825db57) resolves all five dimensions to claude-code / z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx and reports CLI versions 2.1.281 and MCP 0.0.79. I verified every tests_sha256 binding against this frozen source. The inspection deliberately launches /usr/bin/true with constructed arguments (inspect-configured.py:22-23), so it does not demonstrate authentication or provider grading. Raw index SHA256 81d7e30b67ececf39d5d2351a9f41140a8e5e401174e6a80efe9b9d7503791f1 has 239 artifacts; all artifact hashes and five shared-source bindings match. The index scope expressly records missing full configured grading/workload and score evidence. Reused isolation-results.json (SHA256 cc8892bd653a8a5039c526e063e8cef19efaa9d9eb34c6de55ee421d234eb194) is a synthetic historical run on the same shared harness bytes: ordinary_assets runs as UID/GID 65534, hides authentication-marker environment and denies private-file reads while allowing its SQLite positive control. Its assets_symlink case exposes /tests read access but still hides token environment and denies private writes; the actual hosted transfer semantics are unmeasured. This conditional exposure belongs to detailed artifact-isolation reconciliation and is not proof that environment_mode or the frozen credential block is wrong. Note/risk=true preserves the live-authentication/full-run gap and conditional isolation limit. No full configured judge, private deterministic checker, Oracle, target-model or portal result is claimed.
counterexample: Examined a malicious app attempting private-file reads and reward/tool writes through the index-listed raw probe-app.cjs. With ordinary assets those attempts receive EACCES while an ordinary SQLite write succeeds. With /assets symlinked to /tests, the synthetic fixture reads rubric files despite separate-verifier configuration; this does not establish hosted symlink transfer or an earned score. A conforming alternative using permitted public network assets and the expected per-file claude-code fallback must not fail for lacking an allowlist or a local model key; the current profile correctly permits both. A fully conforming app could still receive no genuine grade if runtime credentials are missing or rejected, which source/parser evidence cannot rule out.
suggested_fix: Preserve the shared template configuration. Keep runtime clearance blocked until an authorized full configured provider run establishes authentication/grading; separately measure hosted artifact symlink handling and reconcile the conditional private-file exposure under the isolation check. Do not alter shared harness or claim runtime success from parser/source checks.
